tagline: Eight-ball on a green table. Pull the stick back, let go, take turns.
description:
A full-size 8-ball table: fifteen coloured balls, the black in the triangle, the white on its spot. Red against yellow. Pot your colours, then the black. A foul and you place the white yourself.

On your own you play a computer that tries a handful of shots and picks the best. Two of you can pass the same screen. Or press Invite and a friend takes the other turn on their own phone or computer — there is no game server, no account, and no lobby. The room is the link.

On a phone, put your finger down and pull back to aim; let go to shoot. On a computer, move the mouse to aim, W and S for power, click to shoot.

An unofficial port of Classic Pool Game by henshmi. This copy adds a friend on a second device, and touch.
